اگر بخواهم سادگی (یا سختی) سایت مدنظرم را نشان بدهم، سایت www.saga-co.ir نمونه مناسبی است. با این تفاوت که در سایت ایران ساگا ریموت کنترل تایوانی و چینی یک برند فروخته می شود. اما در سایت مد نظر من کمپرسور و روغن یک برند فروخته می شود (که طبیعتا تفاوتی با هم ندارند).

items.title: SEO Specialist (m/f/n)
items.description:
Summary

Are you passionate about SEO and driving business growth through organic search? We're looking for a Senior SEO Specialist to help shape and execute our global SEO strategy, improve website visibility, and support growth across international markets. You'll work closely with content, development, UX, and marketing teams to deliver impactful SEO initiatives.

Job Description

What will you do?

Conduct keyword research, keyword mapping, and identify search opportunities across multiple markets.
Manage on-page, off-page, and technical SEO activities.
Implement SEO recommendations in CMS platforms, including metadata, redirects, hreflang tags, and internal linking.
Perform SEO audits and identify optimization opportunities.
Analyze competitors and industry trends.
Collaborate with content, UX, CRO, and development teams to implement SEO improvements.
Monitor SEO performance, including traffic, rankings, and technical health.
Support content creation through keyword insights and optimization recommendations.
Help develop and maintain SEO standards and best practices.
Stay up to date with search engine updates and SEO trends.

What are we looking for?

At least 3 years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally in an international environment.
English at C1 level or higher.
Proven track record of growing organic traffic, rankings, and conversions.

Strong knowledge of:

Technical SEO (crawlability, indexing, site structure, redirects, structured data)
On-page and off-page SEO
Keyword research and content optimization
Competitor analysis and market research
Link building and backlink analysis
SEO auditing and performance monitoring
SEO-driven content strategy
HTML and CSS fundamentals

Experience with:

Ahrefs
Semrush
Google Search Console
Google Analytics (GA4)
SEO auditing tools such as Screaming Frog

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail.
Proactive and self-driven approach.
Good organizational and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results.

Why you'll thrive in this role

You'll enjoy this role if you like combining technical SEO, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership, continuously improve performance, and make a measurable impact on organic growth.

Ready to help millions of users discover our products and content through search? We'd love to hear from you.

Basic wage component (gross): from 2800 EUR

Financial bonus based on performance paid twice a year up to 10% from the base salary paid during the evaluation period (normally 6 months).
The final basic wage component can be increased accordingly to individual skills and experience of the selected candidate.

We believe in creating a respectful environment, where everyone feels valued and respected, welcoming applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including race, gender, age, religion, disability, and sexual orientation.

items.title: Senior SEO Specialist
items.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a technically strong Senior SEO Specialist who can independently own SEO projects, from strategy and execution to performance and results.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, analytical, and capable of identifying problems, making informed decisions, and driving projects forward without constant supervision.

Key Responsibilities
Independently manage SEO projects with complete ownership of strategy, execution, timelines, and performance.
Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits, identify critical issues, and work with developers to implement solutions.
Develop and execute SEO strategies covering technical SEO, content, on-page optimization, internal linking, and organic growth.
Stay updated with AEO, GEO, Google AI Overviews, LLM-driven search, and emerging trends in organic discovery.
Analyze performance using GA4, Google Search Console, and other SEO tools to identify opportunities and improve results.
Communicate directly with clients, present recommendations, manage expectations, and ensure timely delivery.

Required Skills & Experience
4 to 5 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably managing multiple accounts in a digital marketing agency.
Strong technical SEO expertise in crawling, indexing, JavaScript SEO, canonicalization, structured data, Core Web Vitals, and site architecture.
Solid understanding of keyword research, search intent, content strategy, topical authority, and on-page SEO.
Working knowledge of AEO, GEO, AI-powered search platforms, and their implications for organic visibility.
Proficiency with Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, and GA4.
Ability to independently troubleshoot complex SEO issues, prioritize initiatives, and deliver measurable outcomes.
Strong communication, client management, and project ownership skills.

Why Bluvo?
Above-market compensation. We would rather invest in one genuinely strong professional than build a larger team that requires constant supervision.
Depth over volume. We intentionally work with a limited number of clients so we can focus on delivering meaningful results.
Meaningful technical work. You'll have the opportunity to investigate complex challenges, develop strategies, and solve problems instead of simply working through tickets.

What Matters Most
We value people who take ownership, think independently, communicate clearly, and follow through on their commitments.

We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks. We want someone who can confidently lead SEO projects, take initiative, and continuously raise the quality of work.

How to Apply
Share your updated resume along with 1 or 2 SEO projects you've independently managed, highlighting the challenges, your contributions, and measurable results.

items.title: Senior SEO/GEO-Specialist
items.description:
På Effektify bygger vi nästa generations marknadsföringsplattform. Genom att kombinera data, AI, automatisering och mänsklig expertis hjälper vi företag att gå från fragmenterad marknadsföring till snabbare beslut, smartare exekvering och bättre affärsresultat.

Sedan starten 2021 har vi vuxit till över 40 medarbetare, 350+ kunder och hjälper idag företag att marknadsföra sig i över 30 marknader. Nu tar vi nästa steg och utvecklar Effektify, med ambitionen att bygga ett internationellt MarTech-bolag från Sverige.

Samtidigt förändras sökbeteendet snabbt. Organisk synlighet handlar inte längre bara om att ranka i Google, utan om att förstå hur varumärken blir synliga, relevanta och rekommenderade i både traditionella sökmotorer och AI-drivna sökupplevelser.

Därför söker vi nu en Senior SEO/GEO-specialist som vill ligga i framkant av den utvecklingen. Du kombinerar djup kompetens inom SEO och AI-sök med stark affärsförståelse och förmågan att omsätta data, teknik och strategi till mätbart värde för våra kunder.

Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill vara med och forma hur framtidens organiska synlighet fungerar och samtidigt skapa verkligt värde för våra kunder.

Varför söka till oss?

Entreprenöriell kultur: här värdesätter vi attityd och personlighet lika mycket som kompetens.
Tillväxtfas med stor påverkan: du kan forma en tjänst som växer snabbt i takt med att sökbeteendet förändras.
Personlig utveckling: hos oss växer du både i din yrkesroll och som individ.

Om rollen

Sök ser inte ut som för ett år sedan. Allt fler frågor besvaras direkt i AI-tjänster, och för våra kunder handlar synlighet nu om att både ranka i Google och bli nämnda och citerade i AI-svar. items.description:
🔴 طراحی وب‌سایتی شبیه استور‌یاب یا ترب

🔹 **عنوان پروژه: طراحی و توسعه وب‌سایت مقایسه و جست‌وجوی محصولات مشابه ترب و استوریاب**
به دنبال یک فریلنسر یا تیم حرفه‌ای برای طراحی و پیاده‌سازی وب‌سایتی با ایده‌ای مشابه پلتفرم‌های جست‌وجو، معرفی و مقایسه محصولات مانند «ترب» و «استوریاب» هستیم. هدف، ایجاد یک وب‌سایت مدرن، زیبا، کاربرپسند و قابل توسعه است که تجربه مناسبی برای کاربران در جست‌وجو و بررسی محصولات یا فروشگاه‌ها فراهم کند.
### شرح کلی پروژه
- طراحی رابط کاربری حرفه‌ای و واکنش‌گرا برای موبایل، تبلت و دسکتاپ
- پیاده‌سازی ساختار و منطق کلی وب‌سایت با الهام از نمونه‌های مشابه
- توجه ویژه به سرعت، سادگی مسیر کاربر و ظاهر مدرن سایت
- امکان توسعه قابلیت‌ها و بخش‌های جدید در آینده
- طراحی پنل مدیریتی مناسب برای مدیریت محتوا، محصولات، دسته‌بندی‌ها و سایر اطلاعات موردنیاز
### قابلیت‌ها و بخش‌های احتمالی
جزئیات نهایی امکانات، میزان شباهت به نمونه‌ها و اولویت‌بندی بخش‌ها در مراحل بعدی مشخص خواهد شد؛ اما پروژه می‌تواند شامل موارد زیر باشد:
- صفحه اصلی و صفحات دسته‌بندی
- جست‌وجوی پیشرفته و فیلتر نتایج
- صفحات معرفی یا جزئیات محصول
- مقایسه قیمت، فروشگاه‌ها یا ویژگی‌های محصولات
- سیستم مدیریت اطلاعات از طریق پنل ادمین
- ثبت، ویرایش و دسته‌بندی محصولات و فروشگاه‌ها
- طراحی بهینه برای موتورهای جست‌وجو (SEO)
- امکان اتصال به API یا منابع داده در صورت نیاز
### مهارت‌ها و انتظارات
- تسلط به طراحی و توسعه وب‌سایت‌های حرفه‌ای
- تجربه در طراحی سایت‌های فروشگاهی، مارکت‌پلیس، موتور جست‌وجو یا مقایسه قیمت مزیت محسوب می‌شود
- توانایی پیشنهاد راهکار فنی مناسب بر اساس نیاز پروژه
- رعایت اصول UI/UX، امنیت، بهینه‌سازی و قابلیت توسعه‌پذیری

items.description:
Sobre Persuadis
En Persuadis somos una agencia de marketing digital especializada en el sector inmobiliario. Trabajamos con promotoras de toda España y hacemos webs, landing pages, campañas de captación de leads, analítica y automatización. Buscamos a alguien que domine el posicionamiento clásico y que entienda cómo está cambiando la búsqueda con la inteligencia artificial.
Qué harás
SEO: auditorías técnicas y on-page, keyword research, arquitectura web, enlazado interno, optimización de contenidos y seguimiento de posiciones para webs corporativas y microsites de promociones.
SEM: crear, gestionar y optimizar campañas de Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display y YouTube) orientadas a la captación de leads cualificados, con control de presupuesto, CPL y conversiones.
GEO (Generative Engine Optimization): trabajar para que nuestros clientes aparezcan y sean citados en respuestas de IA como ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini o Claude. Eso incluye datos estructurados, contenido citable, señales de autoridad y menciones de marca.
Analítica: medir resultados con GA4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console y Looker Studio, y preparar informes claros para el cliente.
Usar herramientas de IA en el día a día para análisis, clustering de keywords, generación y optimización de contenidos, creatividades y automatización de tareas.
Colaborar con los equipos de cuentas, contenidos, diseño y desarrollo web.
Qué buscamos
Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en SEO y/o SEM, en agencia o en cliente.
Dominio de Google Ads, Search Console, GA4 y herramientas como Semrush, Ahrefs o Screaming Frog.
Conocimientos de SEO técnico: indexación, Core Web Vitals, schema.org y WordPress u otros CMS.
Interés real y actualizado por la IA y la búsqueda generativa. Que sigas las novedades, pruebes herramientas nuevas y sepas explicar qué funciona y qué no.
Mentalidad orientada a resultados: tráfico, leads y retorno de la inversión.
Se valorará:
Experiencia en el sector inmobiliario.
Certificaciones de Google Ads.
Experiencia con Meta Ads.
Nociones de automatización con herramientas como Zapier o Make.
Inglés y/o catalán.

Qué ofrecemos
Contrato indefinido a jornada completa.
Salario de 22.000 € a 28.000 € brutos al año, según experiencia.
Horario:
De lunes a jueves, de 8:45 a 14:00 y de 15:00 a 18:00.
Viernes, jornada intensiva de 8:15 a 15:00.
Oficina en Rambla Catalunya 123, Barcelona.
Proyectos para promotoras de primer nivel, con presupuestos de campaña relevantes.
Margen para probar y aplicar nuevas estrategias de IA y GEO, en un área en plena evolución.
Formación continua y un equipo con el que crecer.

This individual will also be responsible for supporting analytics and reporting efforts on a regular basis. This candidate will work independently for the most part; but s/he would be occasionally required to work closely with other teams to identify and improve the technical factors of our site(s) or support cross-functional marketing campaigns.

Analyze select web portals using 3rd party plugins and competitive intelligence tools to identify technical SEO factors or potential link building opportunities.

Identify ways to enable outreach and initiate communication with prospective site owners for link building opportunities – using email, phone calls, social media & other avenues.

Work independently on all aspects of SEO, including keyword research, content strategy, outreach and link building – to enhance organic search visibility for our web properties, blogs and mobile sites.

Manage on-page and off-page SEO efforts by optimizing content, overseeing reporting, conducting regular SEO audits for core keyword groups, and pro-actively seeking out and negotiating relevant link placements on external websites to increase organic rankings.

Monitor, track and report on SEO performance and trends.

Research and stay up-to-date on new developments, trends and technologies within the SEO space.

Minimum of two (2) years experience with advanced level off-page & on-page SEO.

Web analytics experience with knowledge of analytical tools such as Google Analytics & Google Webmaster Tools.

Self-motivated, detail oriented, ability to prioritize, multi-task and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and PHP.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Preferred Skills

items.title: Junior SEO / GEO Specialist
items.description:
Voor deze functie is een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, vereist.

Google, ChatGPT, Claude, AI, zoekgedrag, content en online vindbaarheid. Klinkt interessant? Mooi, want dit kan zomaar jouw wereld worden.

Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar hoe websites bovenaan in Google komen? Waarom ChatGPT bepaalde bedrijven aanbeveelt? En hoe je met slimme content, data en techniek ervoor zorgt dat bedrijven online beter gevonden worden

Dan hebben wij een mooie kans voor je. Bij WebElephant zoeken we een Junior SEO / GEO Specialist die we willen opleiden tot een echte expert in online vindbaarheid. Je hoeft nog niet alles te weten of te kunnen. Als jij nieuwsgierig bent, analytisch denkt en graag nieuwe dingen leert, helpen wij je de rest te ontdekken.

Je werkt vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Breda samen met ervaren online marketeers, developers, contentmakers en designers aan de online groei van onze klanten. Je leert hoe je met SEO én nieuwe AI-technieken impact maakt op hun online zichtbaarheid en resultaat.

Waar jij goed in bent

Jij bent nieuwsgierig en wilt begrijpen hoe dingen werken. Je vindt het leuk om informatie uit te zoeken, verbanden te ontdekken en slimme oplossingen te bedenken.

Misschien heb je tijdens je studie al iets gedaan met online marketing, SEO of AI. Of ben je zelf aan het experimenteren met ChatGPT, websites of content. Hoe dan ook: je wilt er meer over leren.

Bij Ons Leer Je Stap Voor Stap Hoe Je Bedrijven Beter Vindbaar Maakt. Je Gaat Onder Begeleiding Aan De Slag Met

Zoekwoorden en zoekgedrag: onderzoeken waar mensen online naar zoeken en welke kansen dat biedt voor onze klanten.Content optimalisatie: websites en teksten verbeteren zodat ze beter aansluiten op wat mensen zoeken.
Technische SEO: ontdekken hoe zoekmachines websites lezen en welke technische verbeteringen nodig zijn.
SEO-analyses: met tools als Google Search Console, GA4 en Ahrefs onderzoeken hoe websites presteren.
GEO en AI-vindbaarheid: leren hoe bedrijven zichtbaar kunnen worden in AI-platforms zoals ChatGPT, Gemini en Perplexity.
Resultaten verbeteren: samen met collega’s optimalisaties uitvoeren, testen wat werkt en de resultaten inzichtelijk maken.

Je begint met overzichtelijke werkzaamheden en groeit steeds verder naar het zelfstandig analyseren, adviseren en verbeteren van de online vindbaarheid van onze klanten.

SEO in beweging

Online zoeken verandert razendsnel. Waar mensen vroeger vooral Google gebruikten, stellen ze hun vragen nu ook steeds vaker aan AI-platforms zoals ChatGPT en Gemini.

Dat maakt ons vakgebied interessanter dan ooit.

Bij WebElephant kijken we daarom verder dan traditionele SEO. We combineren Search Engine Optimization (SEO) met Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) : zorgen dat bedrijven niet alleen goed gevonden worden in zoekmachines, maar ook zichtbaar zijn in antwoorden van AI-systemen.

Jij krijgt de kans om vanaf het begin mee te groeien in deze ontwikkeling. Je leert van ervaren specialisten, ontdekt nieuwe tools en technieken en krijgt ruimte om zelf te experimenteren.

Wie jij bent en wilt zijn

Je staat aan het begin van je carrière en zoekt een plek waar je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen tot een goede online marketing specialist.

Je hoeft nog geen SEO-expert te zijn. Belangrijker vinden we dat je initiatief toont, kritisch nadenkt en graag wilt begrijpen waarom iets werkt. Je durft vragen te stellen, probeert nieuwe dingen uit en wordt enthousiast van het ontdekken van verbeterkansen.

Je wilt niet alleen leren hoe je websites hoger in Google krijgt, maar ook hoe online vindbaarheid bijdraagt aan meer bezoekers, aanvragen en omzet voor klanten.

Bonuspunten Als Jij

Tijdens je studie, stage of in je vrije tijd al iets hebt gedaan met SEO, websites of online marketing.
Wel eens hebt gewerkt met WordPress, Shopify, Google Analytics of Search Console.
Graag experimenteert met AI-tools zoals ChatGPT.
Affiniteit hebt met e-commerce, IT of webdevelopment.
In (de buurt van) Breda woont.

Nog niet overal ervaring mee? Geen probleem. We zoeken vooral iemand met de juiste nieuwsgierigheid, proactiviteit, motivatie en ambitie.

Klaar om samen met ons te groeien?

Sr. SEO Executive
items.description:
Company Description
Selfcraft Media is a full-service digital marketing agency specializing in systematic, data-driven strategies. The team focuses on crafting cutting-edge marketing solutions tailored to each client’s goals and audience. By leveraging highly influential digital marketing skills, Selfcraft Media builds personalized campaigns designed to deliver measurable results. The agency values creativity, performance, and collaboration in helping clients achieve ambitious growth objectives.

Role Description
We are seeking a results-driven SEO Specialist with 1–5 years of experience in Search Engine Optimization. The ideal candidate should have hands-on expertise in On-Page SEO, Off-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Keyword Research, Content Optimization, and Performance Tracking. The role involves planning and executing SEO strategies to improve organic rankings, drive qualified traffic, and enhance overall website performance.

The candidate will be responsible for conducting SEO audits, optimizing website content and structure, monitoring keyword rankings, implementing technical SEO recommendations, and executing ethical link-building activities. The SEO Specialist will collaborate with content, development, and marketing teams while leveraging tools such as Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Screaming Frog to track performance and identify growth opportunities.A strong analytical mindset, up-to-date knowledge of search engine algorithms, and the ability to deliver measurable organic growth are essential for this role.

Key Responsibilities

On-Page SEO
Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to identify growth opportunities.
Optimize website pages, landing pages, blogs, and product pages for search engines.
Create and implement SEO-friendly meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, and content structures.
Perform content audits and recommend improvements for better search visibility.
Optimize internal linking structures and website architecture.

Off-Page SEO
Develop and execute effective link-building strategies.
Identify and acquire high-quality backlinks from relevant websites.
Monitor backlink profiles and maintain link quality.
Manage local SEO activities, business listings, and citation building.

Technical SEO
Conduct technical SEO audits and identify issues affecting website performance.
Work closely with the development team to resolve crawlability, indexing, and website performance issues.
Monitor Core Web Vitals and website speed optimization.
Implement and validate structured data/schema markup.
Ensure proper implementation of redirects, canonical tags, XML sitemaps, and robots.txt.

Analytics & Reporting
Monitor website performance using SEO tools and analytics platforms.
Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, conversions, and other SEO KPIs.
Prepare weekly and monthly SEO performance reports.
Analyze trends and provide actionable recommendations for continuous improvement.

Content & Growth Strategy
Collaborate with content writers and marketing teams to create SEO-driven content strategies.
Identify opportunities related to GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), Featured Snippets, and AI-driven search trends.
Stay updated with Google algorithm changes and industry best practices.
Support digital marketing initiatives to maximize organic growth.

Required Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, IT, Business, Computer Applications, or a related field.
1–5 years of proven experience in SEO.
Ability to perform comprehensive keyword research and map keywords to relevant pages and topics.
Experience conducting detailed SEO audits to identify technical, on-page, and structural issues.
Skills in ethical link building, including outreach and relationship-based acquisition of quality backlinks.
Proficiency in web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Google Search Console) to monitor performance and derive insights.
Experience with keyword research and competitor analysis tools.
Understanding of schema markup, structured data, and website architecture.
Strong understanding of on-page SEO, including meta tags, headings, URL structure, internal linking, and content optimization.
Knowledge of current SEO best practices, search engine algorithm updates, and industry trends.
Basic familiarity with HTML/CSS and CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress) for implementing SEO recommendations.
Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and present clear, actionable reports.
Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
Relevant experience in SEO or digital marketing; a bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field is preferred.

Preferred Tools:
Google Search Console
Google Analytics (GA4)
Google Tag Manager
Ahrefs
SEMrush
Screaming Frog
Google Keyword Planner
PageSpeed Insights
Google Looker Studio
SEO quake or similar SEO extensions

Key Performance Indicators
Growth in organic traffic.
Improvement in keyword rankings.
Increase in organic conversions and leads.
Technical SEO health score improvement.
Growth in quality backlinks and domain authority.
Increase in Featured Snippets, AEO, and GEO visibility.

Please note that we are only looking for candidates based in Gujarat.

Interested candidates may directly apply or contact us at the provided number: 7878757900

items.company: next level - marketing, creative, PR & digital recruitment
items.description:
Junior SEO Manager
£30,000–£35,000 + bonus | Warwickshire | Hybrid

Are you an SEO Executive ready to take the next step? Or perhaps a Junior SEO Specialist looking for a role where you can really develop your skills and make an impact?
We're working with a growing business looking to take its online presence to the next level, and they're looking for someone who can help make that happen.
This is a brilliant opportunity to get stuck into a broad mix of SEO activity, from keyword research and content optimisation to technical SEO and performance analysis. You'll work closely with the wider marketing team, spot opportunities, share ideas and play a key part in improving organic visibility and driving quality traffic.
There's also the chance to get involved in the exciting world of AI search and GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation). You don't need to be an expert, curiosity and a genuine willingness to learn are far more important!

What you'll be doing
Researching keywords, competitors and new search opportunities.
Optimising website content, landing pages and metadata.
Supporting technical SEO audits and implementing improvements.
Improving site structure, internal linking and overall search performance.
Monitoring and reporting on organic performance using tools such as GA4, Google Search Console and Ahrefs.
Working with the wider team to identify opportunities and improve digital performance.
Keeping up with the latest SEO developments and exploring what's next for search.

What we're looking for
You'll ideally have some hands-on SEO experience and a good understanding of the fundamentals, including keyword research, on-page optimisation and technical SEO.
You'll be comfortable using tools such as Google Search Console and GA4, have some experience with a CMS (WordPress would be great) and enjoy getting to grips with data to understand what's working and where improvements can be made.
More than anything, we're looking for someone who's enthusiastic, proactive and curious about all things search. You don't need to know it all – just bring a willingness to learn, develop and get stuck in!

The details
Salary: £30,000–£35,000 + bonus.
Location: Warwickshire.
Working pattern: Hybrid – three days in the office, two from home.
Holiday: 25 days plus bank holidays.

A great opportunity to build on your SEO experience, learn new skills and be part of a business where you can genuinely make a difference.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you!
